credentialEnvironment.ASC_KEY_ID: App Store Connect API key ID.
credentialEnvironment.ASC_ISSUER_ID: Issuer ID for team keys. Omit when ASC_KEY_TYPE=individual.
credentialEnvironment.ASC_KEY_PATH: Path to the downloaded AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 private key.
credentialEnvironment.ASC_KEY_TYPE: team or individual. Defaults to team.
credentialEnvironment.ASC_API_BASE: Optional API base URL. Defaults to https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com

submissionFieldGroups.notes: The public API can manage existing app records. Create brand-new app records in App Store Connect when the API does not expose the exact setup needed for the account.
Values must honestly reflect app content. Do not lower a rating for marketing reasons.

limits.keywords: 100 characters maximum, comma-separated, no spaces after commas

submissionFieldGroups.notes: Apple may scale highest-resolution screenshots down for smaller sizes when the UI is the same across device sizes.

submissionFieldGroups.resource: Xcode project files and submission config
submissionFieldGroups.notes: The plugin can infer version/build values from project files, git history, and optional Codex iteration counts. It dry-runs by default and updates local project files only after explicit confirmation.

submissionFieldGroups.safety: The plugin requires explicit confirmation before submitting to review.

submissionFieldGroups.resource: inAppPurchases, subscriptions, localizations, prices, review screenshots, submissions
submissionFieldGroups.notes: First-time IAPs and subscriptions are commonly submitted with a new app version. Screenshot copy should make paid or subscription-only features unmistakable. Subscription product prices are separate from app download price.

submissionFieldGroups.resource: Local app implementation guidance and submission config validation
automatableFields: creator override rationale for custom subscription access
submissionFieldGroups.notes: The plugin defaults subscription apps to Free + Pro: roughly 70-80% of useful functionality remains free, while Pro unlocks high-intent depth such as unlimited usage, advanced alerts, widgets, history, exports, insights, or premium personalization. Creators can override the split with an explicit rationale. Apple controls whether the system rating prompt is displayed; the plugin validates trigger policy so requestReview is used after positive non-interruptive outcomes, not launch, onboarding, paywall, purchase, cancellation, or error flows.

submissionFieldGroups.group: Custom product pages and product page optimization
submissionFieldGroups.asaUse: Apple Ads can use approved custom product pages to create ad variations aligned with campaign and keyword intent.

manualOrLimitedFields.field: Paid Apps Agreement, tax, and banking
manualOrLimitedFields.reason: Account/legal setup requires the App Store Connect web experience and authorized account roles.
The audited public OpenAPI spec does not expose privacy questionnaire endpoints. The plugin can prepare a checklist but cannot safely fill those labels by API.
Builds can surface encryption and export compliance requirements; some account-specific documentation or certificates may require manual upload or review.

manualOrLimitedFields.field: Legal, medical, financial, kids, gambling, and regulated claims
manualOrLimitedFields.reason: Codex can draft and validate structure, but the developer must verify factual and legal accuracy before submission.

copyBestPractices.name: Use the clearest searchable brand/category phrase without stuffing.
copyBestPractices.subtitle: State the concrete user outcome in 30 characters or fewer.
copyBestPractices.description: Lead with the strongest benefit in the first sentence, then use concise feature bullets. Avoid prices and keyword stuffing.
copyBestPractices.keywords: Use relevant comma-separated terms, avoid duplicates, category names, competitor names, trademarks, offensive terms, and spaces after commas.
copyBestPractices.promotionalText: Use for current news or offers, not search ranking keywords.
copyBestPractices.screenshots: Make the first one to three images explain the app's core value. Use one benefit per screenshot. Show the Free product as genuinely useful, and mark subscription or paid-only features clearly.
copyBestPractices.customProductPages: Match screenshots, promo text, and keywords to a specific ad group, audience, feature, or seasonal intent.
